# -v and -h print to standard output and succeed.
exec nvtop -v
stdout '^nvtop version 3\.3\.2-go$'
! stderr .

exec nvtop --help
stdout '^Available options:$'
stdout '-s --snapshot'
stdout '^Extensions \(not in nvtop\):$'
stdout '-x --extensions'
! stderr .

# A bad flag or argument prints the help to standard error and fails.
! exec nvtop -Z
stderr 'flag provided but not defined: -Z'
stderr 'Available options:'
! stdout .

! exec nvtop extra
stderr 'unexpected argument "extra"'

! exec nvtop -d -1
stderr 'a negative delay requires a time machine'

! exec nvtop -E soon
stderr 'invalid format for encode/decode hide time: soon'
